presentation.note: He presented the CIG to that meeting. Presenting at a GUDECA meeting is not membership of the chapter — the register has said so since it was written — and none is recorded for him. He is in the register as a member of the Palace family, with no chapter. Recorded here as a presentation, which is what the record establishes.
